label: Весьма
description: A 10-sentence usage card for весьма (very, highly), a bookish intensifier.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Formal intensity. 'Весьма' means very or highly and intensifies 'интересный'. It is a bookish, formal synonym of очень and stands before the word it scales up.

Strategic focus: Formal degree in the past. 'Весьма' intensifies the instrumental adjective 'убедительным', meaning highly convincing. The adverb carries an educated, written register suited to reports.
Strategic focus: Polished satisfaction. 'Весьма' grades 'доволен' to mean very pleased. It precedes the predicate adjective and lends the statement a refined, formal tone.
Strategic focus: Heightened difficulty. 'Весьма' intensifies 'сложная', meaning highly complex. Standing before the adjective, the adverb keeps a formal, almost official flavour.
Strategic focus: Scaling a manner adverb. 'Весьма' modifies 'успешно', meaning very successfully. The adverb precedes the word it grades and gives the sentence a measured, bookish feel.
Strategic focus: Refined description. 'Весьма' intensifies the instrumental 'приятной', meaning very pleasant. The adverb suits polished narration and stands before the adjective it scales.
Strategic focus: Strong evaluation. 'Весьма' grades 'необычное', meaning highly unusual. Placed before the adjective, it keeps the formal register typical of written or careful speech.
Strategic focus: Degree with an adverb. 'Весьма' modifies 'профессионально', meaning very professionally. The adverb stands before the word it intensifies and signals an educated tone.

missions.phrase: Это весьма важно для всех нас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Formal importance. 'Весьма' intensifies the predicate adverb 'важно', meaning highly important. The adverb precedes the word and gives the claim formal weight.
Strategic focus: Polished character note. 'Весьма' grades the instrumental 'любезным', meaning very courteous. The adverb stays before the adjective and keeps the refined, formal register.
